blocks.text: Azimuthal quantum number l, jise angular momentum quantum number bhi kehte hain, har n ke liye 0 se n - 1 tak sahih qeematein le sakta hai, aur orbital ki shakal bayan karta hai. Agar n = 1 to sirf ek qeemat hai, l = 0; agar n = 2 to do, 0 aur 1; agar n = 3 to teen, 0, 1 aur 2; aur agar n = 4 to chaar, 0, 1, 2 aur 3. l ki qeematein huroof s, p, d aur f se zahir hoti hain, jo sharp, principal, diffuse aur fundamental ke liye hain, woh spectral istilahein (terms) jo spectral lakeeron ki kuch khusoosiyat bayan karne ke liye istemal hoti thin. Ek jaise n aur l wale orbitals ka set subshell hai, aur subshell mein electrons ki tadaad 2(2l + 1) hai. Shell mein subshells ki tadaad us ke shell number ke barabar hai: pehle, doosre, teesre aur chauthe shells mein ek, do, teen aur chaar subshells hain.

blocks.caption: n, l aur subshells ka taalluq (Table 2.4)

blocks.prompt: Agar n = 3 aur l = 2 to electron kis shell aur subshell ka hai, aur woh subshell kitne electrons rakh sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: n = 3 M shell hai aur l = 2 d subshell, to electron 3d mein hai. d subshell 2(2 x 2 + 1) = 10 electrons rakhta hai.

items: l 0 se n - 1 tak chalta hai aur shakal tai karta hai: 0 s (spherical), 1 p (dumb-bell), 2 d (clover leaf), 3 f (pecheeda); huroof sharp, principal, diffuse aur fundamental se hain.
Ek jaise n aur l wale orbitals subshell banate hain jo 2(2l + 1) electrons rakhta hai (2, 6, 10, 14); shell mein utne subshells jitna us ka number.
